armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is WORLD EATERS, at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll. To do so, roll eight D6. You can then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne (see below). Each Blessing of Khorne specifies the dice results it requires (where a number is specified, a double or triple of that value or higher is required). You can only activate each Blessing of Khorne once per battle round. Any unused dice from the Blessings of Khorne roll are then discarded. Once activated, each Blessing of Khorne applies to all units from your army with this ability until the end of the battle round.

### The Blessings
▪ **Unbridled Bloodlust (Double 1+):** This unit has +1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
▪ **Rage-Fuelled Invigoration (Double 2+):** Each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
▪ **Total Carnage (Double 3+):** Each time a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
▪ **Martial Excellence (Double 4+ or any Triple):** Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
▪ **Warp Blades (Double 5+ or Triple 2+):** Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
▪ **Decapitating Strikes (Double 6 or Triple 3+):** Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an INFANTRY unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
armyRule.flavor: Khorne is the Chaos god of warfare and slaughter to whom all World Eaters are devoted. He blesses those who spill blood and take skulls in his infernal name.
armyRule.name: Blessings of Khorne

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons (excluding Extra Attacks weapons) equipped by the bearer.
enhancements.flavor: The bearer of this daemon-infested weapon is driven to a state of apoplectic frenzy by the touch of its red-hot grip.
enhancements.name: Berzerker Glaive

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
enhancements.flavor: Khorne’s faithful believe this relic was forged in the depths of the Blood God’s own realm. The blades of many champions have broken upon its brass surface.
enhancements.name: Helm of Brazen Ire

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. Each time you make a Blessings of Khorne roll, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll up to two of the D6 rolled.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior has the favour of Khorne; the Blood God’s infernal power pulses through their veins.
enhancements.name: Favoured of Khorne

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit. In addition, while the Unbridled Bloodlust Blessing of Khorne is active for your army, add 1 to Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.
enhancements.flavor: This veteran killer cannot resist the urge to kill. His endless thirst for slaughter drives him forward into the thickest of fighting.
enhancements.name: Battle-lust

rule.body: Friendly WORLD EATERS units’ melee attacks have +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.
rule.flavor: The World Eaters fight in a perpetual fury, driven ever onward to slaughter all who stand in their path. All of their warriors have been subject to horrific surgery, implanted with crude devices that amplify their aggression. Some even submit to possession by the Blood God’s daemonic servants. These warriors will only stop killing when every foe lies in bloody ruin at their feet - and sometimes not even then.
rule.name: Relentless Rage

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.flavor: Hack and slash, rend and tear, dismember and eviscerate. Kill! Kill! KILL!
stratagems.name: Hack and Slash
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and that made a charge move this turn.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: The depths of their fury lend the devoted of Khorne resilience. Mere flesh wounds will not stay the wrath of the World Eaters.
stratagems.name: Frenzied Resilience
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.flavor: Khorne cares not from whence the blood flows, only that it does. The deaths of his own devoted are fitting offerings.
stratagems.name: Blood Offering
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Any phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.flavor: Those who fight for Khorne are driven to even greater depths of rage, surging towards the foe in a barely controlled tide of bloodthirsty savagery.
stratagems.name: Apoplectic Frenzy
stratagems.target: That Khorne Berzerkers unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a KHORNE BERZERKERS unit from your army is selected to Advance.

stratagems.effect: Make a Blessings of Khorne roll and use the results to activate one Blessing of Khorne. Until the end of the battle round, that Blessing of Khorne is active in addition to any other Blessings of Khorne that are currently active.
stratagems.flavor: The skulls of mighty champions and monstrous foes make a fitting tribute to the Blood God.
stratagems.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne!
stratagems.target: That WORLD EATERS unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army destroys a CHARACTER or MONSTER model.

stratagems.effect: Do not roll a D6 to determine how far models in your unit can move when they make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]**. Instead, when making a **surge move**, those models can move up to 8".
stratagems.flavor: The incessant pounding of the Butcher's Nails drives the World Eaters forward, desperate to salve their agony with blood and gore.
stratagems.name: Berzerker’s Wrath
stratagems.target: One Khorne Berzerkers unit from your army that can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS MONSTER model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer’s Aura abilities.
enhancements.flavor: This immortal being has earned the favour of the Blood God, and its monstrous form is redolent with Khorne’s unholy power.
enhancements.name: Chosen of the Blood God

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS INFANTRY model only. The bearer has the [core:Infiltrators] ability.
enhancements.flavor: Some World Eaters lead packs of cultists into battle, inspiring the masses with their inhuman savagery.
enhancements.name: Butcher Lord

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS MONSTER model only. Add 1 to the bearer’s Toughness characteristic and the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
enhancements.flavor: Whether possessed, colossal daemons or heliforged constructs, Khorne’s diabolic followers have monstrous resilience.
enhancements.name: Brazen Form

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Jakhals and/or Goremongers units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.
enhancements.flavor: Despite the frenzied battle-lust that consumes his soul, this warrior still retains a sliver of the tactical insight instilled in him by his training.
enhancements.name: Strategic Slaughter

rule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Idols of Khorne abilities listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active and its effects apply to all WORLD EATERS TITANIC and WORLD EATERS MONSTER units from your army. You can only select each Idols of Khorne ability once per battle.

Idol of Infinite Rage (Aura)
While a friendly Jakhals or Goremongers unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Idol of Burning Wrath (Aura)
While a friendly JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.

Idol of Blessed Blood (Aura)
While a friendly JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
rule.flavor: Titanic Khornate war engines draw teeming masses of cultists to war.
rule.name: Idols of Khorne

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.
stratagems.flavor: In their feverish desire to slaughter, Khornate cultists scramble and surge to land blows upon the foe.
stratagems.name: Bloodthirsty Horde
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a model in a Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: The demise of this titanic being showers nearby cultists in blood and viscera, inspiring vengeful fury.
stratagems.name: Bloody Vengeance
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS MONSTER or WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit from your army that was just destroyed by an enemy unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Any phase.

stratagems.effect: Select the Idol of Infinite Rage, Idol of Burning Wrath or Idol of Blessed Blood. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Idols of Khorne ability is active for your unit instead of any other Idols of Khorne ability that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.
stratagems.flavor: The greatest idols wrought in Khorne's infernal name bestow myriad blessings upon his faithful.
stratagems.name: Brazen Idol
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS MONSTER or WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
stratagems.flavor: As the bloodshed increases, Jakhals are drawn to the fight like hungry scavengers to a kill.
stratagems.name: Drawn to the Slaughter
stratagems.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units.
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Jakhals unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Any phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within 6" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS MONSTER units, or within 9" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC units, your unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.
stratagems.flavor: Emboldened by blood-slick and skull-laden idols of their dark god, mortal cultists shrug off injury.
stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Brass Idols
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that model’s unit is within 6" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS MONSTER units, or within 9" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC units, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
stratagems.flavor: To fail Khorne is to invite a terrible fate.
stratagems.name: Fail not the Blood God
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. If the bearer’s unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.
enhancements.flavor: An expert in mechanised warfare, the assaults this warrior leads are so swift and violent that few foes can react before the hammer falls.
enhancements.name: Murderous Onslaught

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a Dedicated Transport, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts 9" ability.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior fights in the vanguard, urging his vehicles forward to unload troops as swiftly as possible.
enhancements.name: Aggressive Deployment

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one VEHICLE model within 6" of the bearer or, if the bearer is embarked within a Transport, you can select that TRANSPORT model. Until the end of the phase, after the selected model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
enhancements.flavor: A veteran tank commander, this warrior orders nearby armoured vehicles to lay down a withering field of fire, providing cover for disembarking troops.
enhancements.name: Unleash Hell

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s unit has the Fights First ability.
enhancements.flavor: Provided to veteran World Eaters by the Berzerker-surgeons, these combat stimulants grant the user shocking speed.
enhancements.name: Infernal Infusion

rule.body: Each time a WORLD EATERS unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, add 1 to Charge rolls made for that unit and that unit’s melee weapons have the [LANCE] ability.
rule.flavor: The World Eaters use their vehicles to drive into the heart of the enemy before piling out of their transports and hurling themselves into the fighting.
rule.name: Rush to the Fray

stratagems.effect: One Khorne Berzerkers unit embarked within your model can make a **[gloss:disembark:disembark move]** and then make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6+2".
stratagems.flavor: Khorne Berzerkers react to incoming fire, disembarking to release their pent-up fury.
stratagems.name: Fury Unleashed
stratagems.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Unrelenting Advance Stratagem in the same phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has one or more wounds remaining and was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

stratagems.effect: If your WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.
stratagems.flavor: Having slaughtered their foes, the World Eaters mount up once more to seek new victims.
stratagems.name: Endless Pursuit of Violence
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit from your army and one friendly TRANSPORT that it is able to embark within.
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.flavor: Few obstacles can prevent the World Eaters' eager armoured formations from reaching their prey.
stratagems.name: Smash Through
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS VEHICLE model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: One WORLD EATERS unit embarked within your RHINO can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your RHINO and can be set up within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: Propelled by their bloodlust, the World Eaters spill from their transports and surge towards the foe.
stratagems.name: Aggressive Disembarkation
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a WORLD EATERS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.
stratagems.flavor: With their transports growling with hunger, the World Eaters emerge rapidly to crash headlong into their enemies.
stratagems.name: Full-Throttle Assault
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Your model can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: Incoming fire crashes against corrupted armour, drawing the target closer.
stratagems.name: Unrelenting Advance
stratagems.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Fury Unleashed Stratagem in the same phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS VEHICLE model from your army that was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. While a friendly Blood Legions unit is within 6" of the bearer, that unit has the Blessings of Khorne ability. If the Might of Khorne ability is active for your army, then while a friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit is within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for that unit.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior bears a brass icon redolent with empyric energies. Daemonic entities who gaze upon its macabre magnificence are lent fresh vitality.
enhancements.name: Icon of War

enhancements.body: BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. If the bearer is destroyed, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point.
enhancements.flavor: Made in the depths of the Immaterium, this crimson plate possesses unholy resilience.
enhancements.name: Blood-forged Armour

enhancements.body: Lord on Juggernaut model only. The bearer has the [core:Deep Strike] ability and it has the BLOOD LEGIONS Faction keyword instead of the WORLD EATERS Faction keyword.
enhancements.flavor: This puissant master of carnage has earned the right to lead Khornes immortal legions to war.
enhancements.name: Disciple of Khorne

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. Each time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack, do not roll to gain a Blood Tithe point, you automatically gain 1 Blood Tithe point instead.
enhancements.flavor: This possessed weapon is ever stained with gore and eternally thirsts to taste the blood of fresh victims, empowering the bearer with its endless hunger.
enhancements.name: Blade of Endless Bloodshed

rule.body:
Each time a Blood Legions or World Eaters unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point (BTP). At the start of the Command phase, you can spend one or more of your BTP to activate one of the following abilities until the end of the battle:
▪ **Enraged Abjuration [2BTP]**
BLOOD LEGIONS and WORLD EATERS models from your army have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.
▪ **Daemonic Rage [3BTP]**
Melee weapons equipped by BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army have the [LANCE] ability.
▪ **Boon of Blood [4BTP]**
BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army have a 4+ invulnerable save.
▪ **Might of Khorne [5BTP]**
BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army gain the Blessings of Khorne ability.
rule.flavor: To call forth the blood legions requires the spilling of oceans of crimson gore.
rule.name: Blood Tithe

stratagems.effect: Select one friendly World Eaters unit within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the turn, melee weapons equipped by models in your WORLD EATERS unit have the [LANCE] ability. If the Daemonic Rage ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase those melee weapons also have the [TWIN-LINKED] ability.
stratagems.flavor: The blood legions surge forth from the Warp in a howling tide of carnage, butchering all in their path.
stratagems.name: Daemonic Fury
stratagems.target: One BLOOD LEGIONS unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Start of your Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your WORLD EATERS unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If the Boon of Blood ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase, models in your WORLD EATERS unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.flavor: The weapons of Khorne's craven foes are turned aside by empyric energies.
stratagems.name: Blessing of Burning Blood
stratagems.target: One BLOOD LEGIONS unit from your army that is within 6" of a friendly WORLD EATERS unit that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: You gain D3BTP and you can then spend one or more BTP you have to activate one of the Blood Tithe abilities.
stratagems.flavor: Khorne’s followers seek to claim the skulls of the foe's mightiest champions.
stratagems.name: A Worthy Skull
stratagems.target: That BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit from your army has fought, and one or more enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks.

stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.flavor: With their foes rent asunder, Khornate daemons return to the chaos of the Warp, awaiting the next massacre to strike again.
stratagems.name: Murder-Call
stratagems.target: One BLOOD LEGIONS unit from your army that is on the battlefield and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 9" of that destroyed model and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, then remove the destroyed model from play.
stratagems.flavor: As blood is spilt, the veil between reality and the Warp is eroded, and Khorne’s daemonic legions spill forth at will.
stratagems.name: Summoned by Slaughter
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.
stratagems.target: One Bloodletters unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.when: Any phase, when the last model in a unit is destroyed, before removing it from play. (If that unit is a Transport, any units embarked within that TRANSPORT model must disembark first.)

stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Blood Legions unit within 6" of your unit. One destroyed Mounted model, up to D3 destroyed BEAST models, or up to D6 destroyed INFANTRY models are returned to that BLOOD LEGIONS unit with their full wounds remaining.
stratagems.flavor: As the bloodshed increases, seemingly endless tides of daemons spill from the Warp to bolster the ranks of the blood legions.
stratagems.name: Daemontide
stratagems.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER models to Attached units.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

enhancements.body: Slaughterbound model only. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Brazen Fury move, it is treated as having rolled a 6 for the distance the unit can be moved.
enhancements.flavor: Twin hearts pump molten rage through bulging veins and arteries, daemonic possessor lending its mutated host unnatural speed and endurance.
enhancements.name: Malicious Vigour

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only. Each time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.
enhancements.flavor: The ecstatic release of extreme violence provides momentary clarity to even the most frenzied of minds.
enhancements.name: Killing Clarity

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
enhancements.flavor: This daemon channels its blazing fury with violent precision, its blows as accurate as they are devastating.
enhancements.name: Frenzied Focus

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only. The bearer’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 2+ instead of on a 6. In addition, the bearer has the Deadly Demise D3+1 ability, instead of the Deadly Demise D3 ability.
enhancements.flavor: Upon this daemon’s death, pent-up rage and empyric energies are released in a howling maelstrom of killing force from which there is no escape.
enhancements.name: Violent Demise

rule.body:
WORLD EATERS POSSESSED units from your army have the following ability:

**Brazen Fury:** In your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit was **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6". That **surge move** is a Brazen Fury move.
rule.flavor: Incoming fire serves only to fan the flames of daemonic fury, driving Khorne’s possessed into a malicious rage.
rule.name: Brazen Fury

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to an enemy model, if your unit has the Eightbound keyword and that enemy model is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack. If your unit has the Exalted Eightbound keyword and that enemy model is a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack instead.
stratagems.flavor: Infernal mutations grant the possessed daemonic strength.
stratagems.name: Daemonic Strength
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.flavor: Even as their host's form is destroyed, Khorne's daemons strive to strike a final, vengeful blow.
stratagems.name: Immortal Fury
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Possession lends great resilience.
stratagems.name: Daemonic Resistance
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: Tearing through the fabric of reality, the Exalted Eightbound appear as if from nowhere to loom over their terrified victims.
stratagems.name: Rapid Manifestation
stratagems.restrictions: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
stratagems.target: One Exalted Eightbound unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
stratagems.flavor: Enthralled warriors fall upon their victims in horrifying displays of carnage, sending panic rippling through the enemy ranks.
stratagems.name: Horrifying Violence
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless that move was a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
stratagems.flavor: Possessed warriors surge over and through their allies, swatting lessors aside in their eagerness to slaughter foes.
stratagems.name: Warp Stalkers
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declare a charge this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

enhancements.body: MAULERFIEND unit only. This unit’s Maulerfiend Fists have [CLEAVE 2].
enhancements.flavor: The vicious talons of this daemon engine are said to have been fashioned in the blazing forges of the Blood God’s empyric realm.
enhancements.name: Talons of Butchery

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS VEHICLE unit only. This unit has DAEMON.
enhancements.flavor: Within this armoured shell burns the bloodthirsty essence of a greater daemon of Khorne, its power barely contained.
enhancements.name: Murder-forged Entity

▪ **Terror of Khorne:** At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit engaged with this unit. That enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the **ONSLAUGHT** tag and cannot be taken with another **ONSLAUGHT** **detachment**.
rule.flavor: To stand in the path of stampeding Khornate daemon engines is to know the instinctive terror of cornered prey.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can ignore modifiers to:
▪ BS.
▪ WS.
▪ Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Apoplectic Clarity
stratagems.target: That DAEMON VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DAEMON VEHICLE unit is selected to attack.

stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.
stratagems.flavor: Like a runaway engine of destruction, this Khornate war machine bulldozes a path through even the densest terrain in its urgency to reach the foe.
stratagems.name: Trail of Destruction
stratagems.target: That DAEMON VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly DAEMON VEHICLE unit is selected to move.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
stratagems.flavor: Incensed by the cowardly affront of the foe, this war engine charges down those who would dare fire upon it.
stratagems.name: Goaded to Fury
stratagems.target: That DAEMON VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DAEMON VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) has shot.

enhancements.body: TERMINATOR SQUAD unit only. This unit has +1 OC.
enhancements.flavor: These Terminator-armoured butchers soak the battlefield in gore, and in so doing consecrate it in the name of Khorne.
enhancements.name: Sanctified in Slaughter

enhancements.body: TERMINATOR SQUAD unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have +1 WS.
enhancements.flavor: Countless fields of bloody battle have honed these warriors’ martial skills to the keenest killing edge.
enhancements.name: Gore-stained Veterans

Until the end of the phase, that Blessing of Khorne is active for friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD units in addition to any other Blessings of Khorne that are currently active.
rule.flavor: Hurling themselves into battle with savage ferocity, the sheer armoured bulk of the World Eaters’ Terminator elites is enough to shatter armour and crush bone.
rule.name: Adamantine Avalanche

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.
stratagems.flavor: Fighting with lunatic fierceness, these elite killers hack their victims limb from limb in a blizzard of blows.
stratagems.name: Focused Ferocity
stratagems.target: That TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to Wound rolls.
stratagems.flavor: The greater and more terrible the enemies these warriors face in battle, the mightier the trophies they can take in the Blood God’s name.
stratagems.name: A Trophy for the Throne
stratagems.target: That TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.flavor: So seized by furious bloodlust are these killers that they fight on through even the most grievous mortal wounds.
stratagems.name: Wrath Beyond Reason
stratagems.target: That TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, every Blessing of Khorne is active for this unit until the start of your next turn.
enhancements.flavor: This gifted killer channels the fullness of his rage into every weapon swing — doubly so in that fleeting moment when he believes the Blood God’s gaze has fallen upon him.
enhancements.name: Archslaughterer

enhancements.body:
WORLD EATERS DAEMON PRINCE model only. This model has:
▪ MOBILE.
▪ +1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
enhancements.flavor: With but a stroke of its infernal weapons, this favoured entity can hack paths through the meat of realspace itself to reach the foe all the quicker.
enhancements.name: Gateways to Glory

rule.body:
When a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) is selected to fight, that unit’s CHARACTER models’ melee attacks can have:
▪ [CLEAVE 1].
▪ __Or:__ +1 AP.
rule.flavor: Every Khornate champion treads a personal Path to Glory. Through carnage and bloodshed, they earn empowering boons of martial might.
rule.name: Wrath of Khorne

stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 4+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.
stratagems.flavor: Those who feel Khorne’s blessings burning through their bodies and minds can shrug off hostile witchery with the force of their hate-fuelled contempt.
stratagems.name: Scorn the Witch
stratagems.target: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) suffers a **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s CHARACTER models’ melee attacks have:
▪ +1 A.
▪ +2 S.
stratagems.flavor: Feeling that the Blood God’s eye must surely be sweeping the field of war, his champions strive with wild ferocity to prove themselves.
stratagems.name: Aspire to Infamy
stratagems.target: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) is selected to fight.

stratagems.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that enemy unit must use the Desperate Escape mode. If that enemy unit is **[gloss:battle-shocked:Battle-shocked]**, -1 from those **[gloss:hazard-roll:hazard rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: The Blood God is said to detest cowards. Meting out punishment to such degenerates is believed to be a sure way to win his favour.
stratagems.name: Punish the Craven
stratagems.target: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, if that unit is engaged with a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.

armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is WORLD EATERS, at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll. To do so, roll eight D6. You can then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne (see below). Each Blessing of Khorne specifies the dice results it requires (where a number is specified, a double or triple of that value or higher is required). You can only activate each Blessing of Khorne once per battle round. Any unused dice from the Blessings of Khorne roll are then discarded. Once activated, each Blessing of Khorne applies to all units from your army with this ability until the end of the battle round.

### The Blessings
▪ **Unbridled Bloodlust (Double 1+):** This unit has +1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
▪ **Rage-Fuelled Invigoration (Double 2+):** Each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
▪ **Total Carnage (Double 3+):** Each time a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
▪ **Martial Excellence (Double 4+ or any Triple):** Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
▪ **Warp Blades (Double 5+ or Triple 2+):** Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
▪ **Decapitating Strikes (Double 6 or Triple 3+):** Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an INFANTRY unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
armyRule.flavor: Khorne is the Chaos god of warfare and slaughter to whom all World Eaters are devoted. He blesses those who spill blood and take skulls in his infernal name.
armyRule.name: Blessings of Khorne

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons (excluding Extra Attacks weapons) equipped by the bearer.
enhancements.flavor: The bearer of this daemon-infested weapon is driven to a state of apoplectic frenzy by the touch of its red-hot grip.
enhancements.name: Berzerker Glaive

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
enhancements.flavor: Khorne’s faithful believe this relic was forged in the depths of the Blood God’s own realm. The blades of many champions have broken upon its brass surface.
enhancements.name: Helm of Brazen Ire

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. Each time you make a Blessings of Khorne roll, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll up to two of the D6 rolled.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior has the favour of Khorne; the Blood God’s infernal power pulses through their veins.
enhancements.name: Favoured of Khorne

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit. In addition, while the Unbridled Bloodlust Blessing of Khorne is active for your army, add 1 to Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.
enhancements.flavor: This veteran killer cannot resist the urge to kill. His endless thirst for slaughter drives him forward into the thickest of fighting.
enhancements.name: Battle-lust

rule.body: Friendly WORLD EATERS units’ melee attacks have +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.
rule.flavor: The World Eaters fight in a perpetual fury, driven ever onward to slaughter all who stand in their path. All of their warriors have been subject to horrific surgery, implanted with crude devices that amplify their aggression. Some even submit to possession by the Blood God’s daemonic servants. These warriors will only stop killing when every foe lies in bloody ruin at their feet - and sometimes not even then.
rule.name: Relentless Rage

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.flavor: Hack and slash, rend and tear, dismember and eviscerate. Kill! Kill! KILL!
stratagems.name: Hack and Slash
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and that made a charge move this turn.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: The depths of their fury lend the devoted of Khorne resilience. Mere flesh wounds will not stay the wrath of the World Eaters.
stratagems.name: Frenzied Resilience
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.flavor: Khorne cares not from whence the blood flows, only that it does. The deaths of his own devoted are fitting offerings.
stratagems.name: Blood Offering
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Any phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.flavor: Those who fight for Khorne are driven to even greater depths of rage, surging towards the foe in a barely controlled tide of bloodthirsty savagery.
stratagems.name: Apoplectic Frenzy
stratagems.target: That Khorne Berzerkers unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a KHORNE BERZERKERS unit from your army is selected to Advance.

stratagems.effect: Make a Blessings of Khorne roll and use the results to activate one Blessing of Khorne. Until the end of the battle round, that Blessing of Khorne is active in addition to any other Blessings of Khorne that are currently active.
stratagems.flavor: The skulls of mighty champions and monstrous foes make a fitting tribute to the Blood God.
stratagems.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne!
stratagems.target: That WORLD EATERS unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army destroys a CHARACTER or MONSTER model.

stratagems.effect: Do not roll a D6 to determine how far models in your unit can move when they make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]**. Instead, when making a **surge move**, those models can move up to 8".
stratagems.flavor: The incessant pounding of the Butcher's Nails drives the World Eaters forward, desperate to salve their agony with blood and gore.
stratagems.name: Berzerker’s Wrath
stratagems.target: One Khorne Berzerkers unit from your army that can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS MONSTER model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer’s Aura abilities.
enhancements.flavor: This immortal being has earned the favour of the Blood God, and its monstrous form is redolent with Khorne’s unholy power.
enhancements.name: Chosen of the Blood God

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS INFANTRY model only. The bearer has the [core:Infiltrators] ability.
enhancements.flavor: Some World Eaters lead packs of cultists into battle, inspiring the masses with their inhuman savagery.
enhancements.name: Butcher Lord

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS MONSTER model only. Add 1 to the bearer’s Toughness characteristic and the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
enhancements.flavor: Whether possessed, colossal daemons or heliforged constructs, Khorne’s diabolic followers have monstrous resilience.
enhancements.name: Brazen Form

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Jakhals and/or Goremongers units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.
enhancements.flavor: Despite the frenzied battle-lust that consumes his soul, this warrior still retains a sliver of the tactical insight instilled in him by his training.
enhancements.name: Strategic Slaughter

rule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Idols of Khorne abilities listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active and its effects apply to all WORLD EATERS TITANIC and WORLD EATERS MONSTER units from your army. You can only select each Idols of Khorne ability once per battle.

Idol of Infinite Rage (Aura)
While a friendly Jakhals or Goremongers unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Idol of Burning Wrath (Aura)
While a friendly JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.

Idol of Blessed Blood (Aura)
While a friendly JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
rule.flavor: Titanic Khornate war engines draw teeming masses of cultists to war.
rule.name: Idols of Khorne

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.
stratagems.flavor: In their feverish desire to slaughter, Khornate cultists scramble and surge to land blows upon the foe.
stratagems.name: Bloodthirsty Horde
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a model in a Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: The demise of this titanic being showers nearby cultists in blood and viscera, inspiring vengeful fury.
stratagems.name: Bloody Vengeance
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS MONSTER or WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit from your army that was just destroyed by an enemy unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Any phase.

stratagems.effect: Select the Idol of Infinite Rage, Idol of Burning Wrath or Idol of Blessed Blood. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Idols of Khorne ability is active for your unit instead of any other Idols of Khorne ability that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.
stratagems.flavor: The greatest idols wrought in Khorne's infernal name bestow myriad blessings upon his faithful.
stratagems.name: Brazen Idol
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS MONSTER or WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
stratagems.flavor: As the bloodshed increases, Jakhals are drawn to the fight like hungry scavengers to a kill.
stratagems.name: Drawn to the Slaughter
stratagems.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units.
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Jakhals unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Any phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within 6" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS MONSTER units, or within 9" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC units, your unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.
stratagems.flavor: Emboldened by blood-slick and skull-laden idols of their dark god, mortal cultists shrug off injury.
stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Brass Idols
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that model’s unit is within 6" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS MONSTER units, or within 9" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC units, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
stratagems.flavor: To fail Khorne is to invite a terrible fate.
stratagems.name: Fail not the Blood God
stratagems.sublabel: Cult of Blood – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. If the bearer’s unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.
enhancements.flavor: An expert in mechanised warfare, the assaults this warrior leads are so swift and violent that few foes can react before the hammer falls.
enhancements.name: Murderous Onslaught

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a Dedicated Transport, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts 9" ability.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior fights in the vanguard, urging his vehicles forward to unload troops as swiftly as possible.
enhancements.name: Aggressive Deployment

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one VEHICLE model within 6" of the bearer or, if the bearer is embarked within a Transport, you can select that TRANSPORT model. Until the end of the phase, after the selected model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
enhancements.flavor: A veteran tank commander, this warrior orders nearby armoured vehicles to lay down a withering field of fire, providing cover for disembarking troops.
enhancements.name: Unleash Hell

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s unit has the Fights First ability.
enhancements.flavor: Provided to veteran World Eaters by the Berzerker-surgeons, these combat stimulants grant the user shocking speed.
enhancements.name: Infernal Infusion

rule.body: Each time a WORLD EATERS unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, add 1 to Charge rolls made for that unit and that unit’s melee weapons have the [LANCE] ability.
rule.flavor: The World Eaters use their vehicles to drive into the heart of the enemy before piling out of their transports and hurling themselves into the fighting.
rule.name: Rush to the Fray

stratagems.effect: One Khorne Berzerkers unit embarked within your model can make a **[gloss:disembark:disembark move]** and then make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6+2".
stratagems.flavor: Khorne Berzerkers react to incoming fire, disembarking to release their pent-up fury.
stratagems.name: Fury Unleashed
stratagems.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Unrelenting Advance Stratagem in the same phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has one or more wounds remaining and was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

stratagems.effect: If your WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.
stratagems.flavor: Having slaughtered their foes, the World Eaters mount up once more to seek new victims.
stratagems.name: Endless Pursuit of Violence
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit from your army and one friendly TRANSPORT that it is able to embark within.
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.flavor: Few obstacles can prevent the World Eaters' eager armoured formations from reaching their prey.
stratagems.name: Smash Through
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS VEHICLE model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: One WORLD EATERS unit embarked within your RHINO can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your RHINO and can be set up within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: Propelled by their bloodlust, the World Eaters spill from their transports and surge towards the foe.
stratagems.name: Aggressive Disembarkation
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a WORLD EATERS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.
stratagems.flavor: With their transports growling with hunger, the World Eaters emerge rapidly to crash headlong into their enemies.
stratagems.name: Full-Throttle Assault
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Your model can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: Incoming fire crashes against corrupted armour, drawing the target closer.
stratagems.name: Unrelenting Advance
stratagems.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Fury Unleashed Stratagem in the same phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS VEHICLE model from your army that was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. While a friendly Blood Legions unit is within 6" of the bearer, that unit has the Blessings of Khorne ability. If the Might of Khorne ability is active for your army, then while a friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit is within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for that unit.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior bears a brass icon redolent with empyric energies. Daemonic entities who gaze upon its macabre magnificence are lent fresh vitality.
enhancements.name: Icon of War

enhancements.body: BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. If the bearer is destroyed, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point.
enhancements.flavor: Made in the depths of the Immaterium, this crimson plate possesses unholy resilience.
enhancements.name: Blood-forged Armour

enhancements.body: Lord on Juggernaut model only. The bearer has the [core:Deep Strike] ability and it has the BLOOD LEGIONS Faction keyword instead of the WORLD EATERS Faction keyword.
enhancements.flavor: This puissant master of carnage has earned the right to lead Khornes immortal legions to war.
enhancements.name: Disciple of Khorne

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. Each time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack, do not roll to gain a Blood Tithe point, you automatically gain 1 Blood Tithe point instead.
enhancements.flavor: This possessed weapon is ever stained with gore and eternally thirsts to taste the blood of fresh victims, empowering the bearer with its endless hunger.
enhancements.name: Blade of Endless Bloodshed

rule.body:
Each time a Blood Legions or World Eaters unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point (BTP). At the start of the Command phase, you can spend one or more of your BTP to activate one of the following abilities until the end of the battle:
▪ **Enraged Abjuration [2BTP]**
BLOOD LEGIONS and WORLD EATERS models from your army have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.
▪ **Daemonic Rage [3BTP]**
Melee weapons equipped by BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army have the [LANCE] ability.
▪ **Boon of Blood [4BTP]**
BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army have a 4+ invulnerable save.
▪ **Might of Khorne [5BTP]**
BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army gain the Blessings of Khorne ability.
rule.flavor: To call forth the blood legions requires the spilling of oceans of crimson gore.
rule.name: Blood Tithe

stratagems.effect: Select one friendly World Eaters unit within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the turn, melee weapons equipped by models in your WORLD EATERS unit have the [LANCE] ability. If the Daemonic Rage ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase those melee weapons also have the [TWIN-LINKED] ability.
stratagems.flavor: The blood legions surge forth from the Warp in a howling tide of carnage, butchering all in their path.
stratagems.name: Daemonic Fury
stratagems.target: One BLOOD LEGIONS unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Start of your Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your WORLD EATERS unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If the Boon of Blood ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase, models in your WORLD EATERS unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.flavor: The weapons of Khorne's craven foes are turned aside by empyric energies.
stratagems.name: Blessing of Burning Blood
stratagems.target: One BLOOD LEGIONS unit from your army that is within 6" of a friendly WORLD EATERS unit that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: You gain D3BTP and you can then spend one or more BTP you have to activate one of the Blood Tithe abilities.
stratagems.flavor: Khorne’s followers seek to claim the skulls of the foe's mightiest champions.
stratagems.name: A Worthy Skull
stratagems.target: That BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit from your army has fought, and one or more enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks.

stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.flavor: With their foes rent asunder, Khornate daemons return to the chaos of the Warp, awaiting the next massacre to strike again.
stratagems.name: Murder-Call
stratagems.target: One BLOOD LEGIONS unit from your army that is on the battlefield and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 9" of that destroyed model and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, then remove the destroyed model from play.
stratagems.flavor: As blood is spilt, the veil between reality and the Warp is eroded, and Khorne’s daemonic legions spill forth at will.
stratagems.name: Summoned by Slaughter
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.
stratagems.target: One Bloodletters unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.when: Any phase, when the last model in a unit is destroyed, before removing it from play. (If that unit is a Transport, any units embarked within that TRANSPORT model must disembark first.)

stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Blood Legions unit within 6" of your unit. One destroyed Mounted model, up to D3 destroyed BEAST models, or up to D6 destroyed INFANTRY models are returned to that BLOOD LEGIONS unit with their full wounds remaining.
stratagems.flavor: As the bloodshed increases, seemingly endless tides of daemons spill from the Warp to bolster the ranks of the blood legions.
stratagems.name: Daemontide
stratagems.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER models to Attached units.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

enhancements.body: Slaughterbound model only. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Brazen Fury move, it is treated as having rolled a 6 for the distance the unit can be moved.
enhancements.flavor: Twin hearts pump molten rage through bulging veins and arteries, daemonic possessor lending its mutated host unnatural speed and endurance.
enhancements.name: Malicious Vigour

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only. Each time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.
enhancements.flavor: The ecstatic release of extreme violence provides momentary clarity to even the most frenzied of minds.
enhancements.name: Killing Clarity

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
enhancements.flavor: This daemon channels its blazing fury with violent precision, its blows as accurate as they are devastating.
enhancements.name: Frenzied Focus

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only. The bearer’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 2+ instead of on a 6. In addition, the bearer has the Deadly Demise D3+1 ability, instead of the Deadly Demise D3 ability.
enhancements.flavor: Upon this daemon’s death, pent-up rage and empyric energies are released in a howling maelstrom of killing force from which there is no escape.
enhancements.name: Violent Demise

rule.body:
WORLD EATERS POSSESSED units from your army have the following ability:

**Brazen Fury:** In your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit was **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6". That **surge move** is a Brazen Fury move.
rule.flavor: Incoming fire serves only to fan the flames of daemonic fury, driving Khorne’s possessed into a malicious rage.
rule.name: Brazen Fury

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to an enemy model, if your unit has the Eightbound keyword and that enemy model is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack. If your unit has the Exalted Eightbound keyword and that enemy model is a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack instead.
stratagems.flavor: Infernal mutations grant the possessed daemonic strength.
stratagems.name: Daemonic Strength
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.flavor: Even as their host's form is destroyed, Khorne's daemons strive to strike a final, vengeful blow.
stratagems.name: Immortal Fury
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Possession lends great resilience.
stratagems.name: Daemonic Resistance
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: Tearing through the fabric of reality, the Exalted Eightbound appear as if from nowhere to loom over their terrified victims.
stratagems.name: Rapid Manifestation
stratagems.restrictions: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
stratagems.target: One Exalted Eightbound unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
stratagems.flavor: Enthralled warriors fall upon their victims in horrifying displays of carnage, sending panic rippling through the enemy ranks.
stratagems.name: Horrifying Violence
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless that move was a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
stratagems.flavor: Possessed warriors surge over and through their allies, swatting lessors aside in their eagerness to slaughter foes.
stratagems.name: Warp Stalkers
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declare a charge this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

enhancements.body: MAULERFIEND unit only. This unit’s Maulerfiend Fists have [CLEAVE 2].
enhancements.flavor: The vicious talons of this daemon engine are said to have been fashioned in the blazing forges of the Blood God’s empyric realm.
enhancements.name: Talons of Butchery

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS VEHICLE unit only. This unit has DAEMON.
enhancements.flavor: Within this armoured shell burns the bloodthirsty essence of a greater daemon of Khorne, its power barely contained.
enhancements.name: Murder-forged Entity

rule.body:
Friendly DAEMON VEHICLE units have the following ability:
▪ **Terror of Khorne:** At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit engaged with this unit. That enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the **ONSLAUGHT** tag and cannot be taken with another **ONSLAUGHT** **detachment**.
rule.flavor: To stand in the path of stampeding Khornate daemon engines is to know the instinctive terror of cornered prey.
rule.name: Rampaging Terrors

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can ignore modifiers to:
▪ BS.
▪ WS.
▪ Hit rolls and Wound rolls.
stratagems.flavor: So perfect a state of supernatural rage does this ironclad entity exist in that nothing can distract it from its single-minded slaughter.
stratagems.name: Apoplectic Clarity
stratagems.target: That DAEMON VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DAEMON VEHICLE unit is selected to attack.

stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.
stratagems.flavor: Like a runaway engine of destruction, this Khornate war machine bulldozes a path through even the densest terrain in its urgency to reach the foe.
stratagems.name: Trail of Destruction
stratagems.target: That DAEMON VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly DAEMON VEHICLE unit is selected to move.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
stratagems.flavor: Incensed by the cowardly affront of the foe, this war engine charges down those who would dare fire upon it.
stratagems.name: Goaded to Fury
stratagems.target: That DAEMON VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DAEMON VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) has shot.

enhancements.body: TERMINATOR SQUAD unit only. This unit has +1 OC.
enhancements.flavor: These Terminator-armoured butchers soak the battlefield in gore, and in so doing consecrate it in the name of Khorne.
enhancements.name: Sanctified in Slaughter

enhancements.body: TERMINATOR SQUAD unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have +1 WS.
enhancements.flavor: Countless fields of bloody battle have honed these warriors’ martial skills to the keenest killing edge.
enhancements.name: Gore-stained Veterans

rule.body: At the start of the Fight phase, if a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is engaged, make a Blessings of Khorne roll and use the results to activate one Blessing of Khorne. Until the end of the phase, that Blessing of Khorne is active for friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD units in addition to any other Blessings of Khorne that are currently active.
rule.flavor: Hurling themselves into battle with savage ferocity, the sheer armoured bulk of the World Eaters’ Terminator elites is enough to shatter armour and crush bone.
rule.name: Adamantine Avalanche

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.
stratagems.flavor: Fighting with lunatic fierceness, these elite killers hack their victims limb from limb in a blizzard of blows.
stratagems.name: Focused Ferocity
stratagems.target: That TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to Wound rolls.
stratagems.flavor: The greater and more terrible the enemies these warriors face in battle, the mightier the trophies they can take in the Blood God’s name.
stratagems.name: A Trophy for the Throne
stratagems.target: That TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.flavor: So seized by furious bloodlust are these killers that they fight on through even the most grievous mortal wounds.
stratagems.name: Wrath Beyond Reason
stratagems.target: That TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.

enhancements.body: WORLD EATERS model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, every Blessing of Khorne is active for this unit until the start of your next turn.
enhancements.flavor: This gifted killer channels the fullness of his rage into every weapon swing — doubly so in that fleeting moment when he believes the Blood God’s gaze has fallen upon him.
enhancements.name: Archslaughterer

enhancements.body:
WORLD EATERS DAEMON PRINCE model only. This model has:
▪ MOBILE.
▪ +1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
enhancements.flavor: With but a stroke of its infernal weapons, this favoured entity can hack paths through the meat of realspace itself to reach the foe all the quicker.
enhancements.name: Gateways to Glory

rule.body:
When a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) is selected to fight, that unit’s CHARACTER models’ melee attacks can have:
▪ [CLEAVE 1].
▪ __Or:__ +1 AP.
rule.flavor: Every Khornate champion treads a personal Path to Glory. Through carnage and bloodshed, they earn empowering boons of martial might.
rule.name: Wrath of Khorne

stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 4+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.
stratagems.flavor: Those who feel Khorne’s blessings burning through their bodies and minds can shrug off hostile witchery with the force of their hate-fuelled contempt.
stratagems.name: Scorn the Witch
stratagems.target: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) suffers a **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s CHARACTER models’ melee attacks have:
▪ +1 A.
▪ +2 S.
stratagems.flavor: Feeling that the Blood God’s eye must surely be sweeping the field of war, his champions strive with wild ferocity to prove themselves.
stratagems.name: Aspire to Infamy
stratagems.target: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) is selected to fight.

stratagems.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that enemy unit must use the Desperate Escape mode. If that enemy unit is **[gloss:battle-shocked:Battle-shocked]**, -1 from those **[gloss:hazard-roll:hazard rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: The Blood God is said to detest cowards. Meting out punishment to such degenerates is believed to be a sure way to win his favour.
stratagems.name: Punish the Craven
stratagems.target: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, if that unit is engaged with a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
